column1: # The tools' own labels that the guides quote (guide-steps.tsv), as each tool's source has them at guides.tsv's commit.
# They are data, not Datapavan's words: never translated by ADR 0030's process. Where the tool is installed, Advanced reads
# the label from the tool itself by its resource name, in the tool's language (guides/ToolLabels.kt); otherwise it shows
# the text here, in the phone's language where the tool's source has it, else in English.
#   key       the label's name within the guide
#   lang      en, or one of Datapavan's other languages (fa, ar, ru, zh, fr, de, es) where the tool has it in i18n files
#   text      the label as the source has it, unescaped
#   resource  the tool's Android resource: string/NAME, or array/NAME/INDEX for an item of a string array; '-' where the
#             label is not an Android string resource (Flutter i18n files, or text written in code)
#   source    the line of the source that holds the text
